headline: ILLIT's Moka to gradually return after 5-month break
sub: "I've been waiting for this day," she tells fans on Weverse
source: Source: Moka's Weverse post, via Korean media
caption:
ILLIT's Moka says she will gradually return to activities after about five months off.

In a Weverse post on Nov 27, Moka thanked GLLIT for waiting and said she will slowly rejoin the members, asking fans to wait for her patiently. She had paused all activities on Jun 19 to focus on her health. No specific return date has been announced yet.

📌 Source: Moka's Weverse post, via Korean media (Tenasia, Newsen)
